top_creatures.label: Three-stage flesh climber
top_creatures.why: three named stages with hp 100, 200, 400 and speed 50, 80, 140; each stage is a new threat
top_creatures.keep: stage chain where hp and speed rise together; timed upgrade step
top_creatures.change: silhouette (bark-plated giant); palette; stage triggers by fight state

top_creatures.label: Limbed shard crab
top_creatures.why: 2400 hp body with 400 hp legs; a leg collapse fires a hurt event
top_creatures.keep: limbs as separate hp pools; limb collapse as a mid-fight event
top_creatures.change: crab silhouette; leg tells; event drops a guard rather than a text message

top_creatures.label: Gilded sentinel
top_creatures.why: immobile, pacifist landmark that casts spells; placed as a zone landmark

top_creatures.label: Event-horizon hoarder
top_creatures.why: immobile boss, 3000 hp, six spells; its spawns split off and burst into a bigger form
top_creatures.keep: boss whose spawn becomes a bigger threat on death
top_creatures.change: silhouette; a timed split at half hp instead

top_creatures.label: Carapace raider squad
top_creatures.why: seven roles in one family, read by colour and loadout; guards stun with a shriek and a taser
top_creatures.keep: one family, roles by colour and kit
top_creatures.change: colours; silhouettes; stun as a telegraphed pulse

top_creatures.label: Tentacle matriarch
top_creatures.why: 850 hp, speed 120; grab-drag, drag follow-up, then a long barbed tentacle
top_creatures.change: pull direction; tells; one target at a time for many-on-one

top_creatures.label: Axis-locked line-walkers
top_creatures.why: three colours each locked to one axis with a ranged pull; vanish message on death
top_creatures.change: our own lock (lanes); no dimension lore

top_creatures.label: Spore-stalked dead
top_creatures.why: three-stage transformation of a known enemy; death bursts from the spore stage
top_creatures.keep: visible three-stage change of a known enemy type
top_creatures.change: our growth tells; a burst that is not fungus
